task: R_cross_sym: cross-sym features (mean/std/rank/zscore over other 4 syms at same (date,t)) on T75 LGB L2 baseline
reason: Cross-sym features cannot be computed at inference time under platform contract: (a) date is zeroed, (b) sym/date/time absent from config.feature, (c) test order shuffled, so same-(date,t) rows from different syms cannot be aligned in predict(). The PM-proposed 'constants-per-sym' fallback also fails because sym is unknown/untrustworthy at eval. Training with cross-sym features that are absent (or constant) at inference is strictly worse than the baseline that omits them.

evidence.train_data_5_sym_alignment: 100% (verified: all 80 train dates have all 5 syms; 2001 (date,time) groups per session each with 5 syms)
constraint_violations: CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS §1.1 date=0 → cannot identify (date,t) at inference
CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS §1.2 shuffled order → no cross-call alignment
CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS §1.3 sym may be unseen → cannot index per-sym lookups

recommended_alternative.name: cross_sym_distillation
recommended_alternative.summary: Train a TEACHER LGB with cross-sym features at train time (where alignment is trivial). Generate teacher predictions. Train a STUDENT LGB with only the 359 sym-agnostic features against a soft target mixing y_orig and y_teacher. Ship the STUDENT — fully contract-compliant. Estimated effort: 2-3 hours.
recommended_alternative.estimated_loso_lift: uncertain; depends on teacher lift (HYD reports 1-3) and student's recoverable fraction

notes: Decision made by contract analysis, not by training. See REPORT.md §2 for the four-row failure table and §6 for the recommended alternative.
